svg.aria-label: Dumbbell goblet squat, Upright: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell upright against your chest.
svg.title: Dumbbell goblet squat, Upright: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart, holding one dumbbell upright against your chest.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell goblet squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees together, heels down, knees following your toes.
svg.title: Dumbbell goblet squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees together, heels down, knees following your toes.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell goblet squat, Bottom: Squat as low as you can control with your heels down and the dumbbell at your chest.
svg.title: Dumbbell goblet squat, Bottom: Squat as low as you can control with your heels down and the dumbbell at your chest.

svg.aria-label: Dumbbell goblet squat, Stand: Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
svg.title: Dumbbell goblet squat, Stand: Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
